items.context: QTRResearch: «La power law no es lo que hace valioso a Bitcoin, lo hace la adopción», y ningún modelo o ecuación cambia eso. Post de hace ~11 min con 16 likes y 0 respuestas; toca a la vez la power law y la adopción.
items.suggested_text:
Agreed on the direction of causality, and I'd take it one step further: the power law is arguably adoption seen through a price lens. The curve doesn't create value; it summarizes how a network that keeps adding holders has been priced over time.

Where it gets useful is when the two diverge. $BTC fell 32% over the past year and the network still added 2.5M funded addresses. 1M in 2012, 10M in 2016, 50M in 2023. Price wandered far from trend; the base of holders kept compounding.

A model breaks when the adoption underneath it changes shape, not when price drifts away from the line. Which one is actually slowing right now is the part worth watching.
